Study Title: Cetuxibab to Reduce Circulating Tumor Cells in Early Stage NSCLC
Brief Summary: Cetuximab to reduce the amound of circulating tumor cells in early stage NSCLC
Primary Outcome Measures: reduction of circulating tumor cells, The primary objective of this study is to determine whether a single neoadjuvant dose of cetuximab (anti-EGFR mAb) - administered 72 to 48 hours prior to surgery - will reduce the number of CTCs in patients. The reduction of CTCs will be expressed in percentage as more or less than 50% changed from baseline., From date of registration until CTC measurement at 3 months after surgery.
